# AISEOShift

> AISEOShift covers the shift from blue-link SEO to AI search visibility: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Overviews, citations, schema, and the practical playbooks brands and agencies use to get cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, and Gemini.

Author: Shashank Dubey, founder of Wbcom Designs and lead writer at AISEOShift. All content is written for practitioners and grounded in how AI answer engines select and cite sources.

## Start here

- [The AI SEO Shift](https://aiseoshift.com/ai-seo-shift/): the pillar explaining the move from rankings to AI answer citations, combining classical SEO, AEO, and GEO.
- [What Is AI Visibility?](https://aiseoshift.com/blog/what-is-ai-visibility/): definition of AI visibility and why it is the new measure of search success.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://aiseoshift.com/aeo/): structuring content so AI answer engines extract, trust, and cite it.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://aiseoshift.com/geo/): being the source generative AI search builds its answers from.

## Measurement

- [How to Measure AI Visibility](https://aiseoshift.com/blog/how-to-measure-ai-visibility/): the metrics, framework, and cadence for AI search performance.
- [AEO KPIs and Metrics](https://aiseoshift.com/blog/aeo-kpis-metrics-ai-visibility/): citation rate, share of voice, zero-click impression share, brand entity strength, platform coverage.
- [How to Get Cited by AI Search Systems](https://aiseoshift.com/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-ai-search-systems/): the content and authority signals that earn citations.
